timeline.summary: 07 May 2026: Office of the Commissioner of Customs, Pune dropped a ₹6.37 Cr IGST short-levy demand against Carraro India in full.

Carraro India Limited’s **Mohith Kumar Khandelwal** schedules Q4 FY26 earnings conference call with **Dr. Balaji Gopalan (MD)** and **Davide Grossi (WTD & CFO)** on **27 May 2026 at 08:30 AM IST** to discuss financial results.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹606.72 Cr (+36.6% YoY), net profit ₹41.69 Cr.
Carraro India Limited shared the audio recording of its earnings conference call on May 27, 2026, for Q4FY26 and FY26 results via its website.
Carraro India reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹607 Cr (+37% YoY) and recommended a final dividend of ₹6.75 per share.

Carraro India Limited schedules earnings conference call on **6th November 2026 at 6:00 PM IST** to discuss Q2 & H1 FY27 unaudited results with **Dr. Balaji Gopalan (MD), Davide Grossi (WTD & CFO), and management**.
